name: Social Cross-Poster - Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn

parameters.content:
## What this workflow does

You write the post once — text, an optional image URL, and
hashtags — and this workflow publishes it to a Facebook Page,
an Instagram Business account, X, and LinkedIn. Each platform
gets its own text adaptation, and each platform fails
independently without blocking the others.

**New concepts vs. the previous workflows:**
- Code node as the single content/config source
- Per-platform text adaptation (X 280 chars, Instagram 2200)
- IF branching + Merge (append) to rejoin both paths
- onError: continueRegularOutput — one platform failing
  never stops the others
- Native node (X) vs raw HTTP Request (Meta Graph API,
  LinkedIn UGC) — use the native node when it handles
  OAuth2 signing for you

### Setup (one time, ~15 minutes)

1. Create 3 credentials in n8n — Settings > Credentials >
   Add credential: "Facebook Graph API", "X (Twitter)
   OAuth2 API", "LinkedIn OAuth2 API"
2. Attach them to the Facebook/Instagram, X, and LinkedIn
   nodes (the nodes show REPLACE_WITH_* until you do)
3. Replace the REPLACE_WITH_* values in Prepare Post:
   post text, image URL, page ID, Instagram Business
   User ID, LinkedIn author URN

> The full steps live in the README.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ author: $('Prepare Post').item.json.linkedInAuthorUrn, lifecycleState: 'PUBLISHED', specificContent: { 'com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent': { shareCommentary: { text: $('Prepare Post').item.json.linkedInText }, shareMediaCategory: 'NONE' } }, visibility: { 'com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility': 'PUBLIC' } }
